idea-plugin.name: Pi Coding Agent GUI
idea-plugin.description:
Pi Coding Agent brings the pi coding agent to JetBrains IDEs with a focused chat tool window, session persistence, protected tool output, editor context sharing, and configurable Node.js and pi CLI paths.

Features
  • Chat with pi directly inside the IDE.
  • Persist and restore pi sessions across IDE restarts.
  • Display protected tool output, including files, terminals, and patches.
  • Follow the IDE light and dark themes automatically.
  • Attach the selected editor text as context for a conversation.
  • Configure the pi CLI path, Node.js runtime, and working directory.

Requirement: Install the pi CLI before use, for example with npm install -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent.

Source code and issue tracker: https://github.com/Cyber0xFE/pi-jetbrains-gui
